create_multi_corpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusSampledDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with uniform sampling
build_custom_sampler: build a custom sampling function to replace the default uniform_sampler for dataset selection
collate_multi_corpus_batch: collate a mini-batch by sampling a dataset key and delegating to its collater method
map_index_to_dataset: map a global index to a per-dataset index using modulo wrapping across underlying datasets
prefetch_multi_corpus_indices: prefetch data for mapped indices across all underlying FairseqDataset instances in the multi-corpus dataset
